senses.gloss: m. (ἀρτόκοπος) baker, בית א׳ bakery. Midr. Sam. ch. XIX בית א׳ שלו (Var. ארתוקופיון q. v.) a rendition of beth hallaḥmi, I Sam. XVI,

to his (Jesse’s) bakery, <he>שהוא בא וכ׳</he> (read with <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 124:3">Yalk. Sam. 124</cite> <he>והוא יבוא וכ׳</he>) and he (Jesse) shall come out (to the bakery) from Bethlehem (to meet Samuel there). Yalk. l. c. <cite ref="A03206"><he>ארנקפאן</he></cite>, <he>ארכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
